featured_reviews.review_text:
My Google Review # 000240.

Have visited this store for hardware and plumbing requirement couple of times.

They are under-staffed, over-priced and also do not pay attention to what you are exactly wanting. The staff kept is just from their native villages and does not even know most of the things.

Long time ago, ROYAL was a sure-shot place to get your stuff. But, not anymore. They have neither upgraded themselves nor the shop nor the staff.

To hang glass shelves, they gave me 0.1mm thk steel bracket, which I insisted on replacing. But they did not listen. This is just one example of the many other experiences I had here. The cashier – probably the owner – seems interested in just collecting money over some handwritten bills.

THE MOST IMPORTANT point - they do not accept cards... Only cash or GPAY... How much more do they want to promote - unrecorded transactions???

Seriously, not even worth a visit. There are countless and much better hardware shops opened up across Mira Road and Bhayander. Your carpenter may drag you to this place, but be aware. There is good variety available else where also.

DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME HERE.

Date of Experience # April 2021.
